title: user_data_templates
description: Value of the `user_data_templates` config: the templates Roblox follows to delete a user's data on right-to-be-forgotten requests. Either the array Roblox stores, or a name -> template map pushed as an array with `as_array: true` (names only label entries locally). See https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud-services/data-stores/right-to-be-forgotten#configure-automated-rtbf-via-configs-api

map.description: Name -> template, pushed as an array with `as_array: true`: names keep their synced slot, new ones follow by name. Up to 100 templates.

template.description: Matches a data store key (`key_template`) or a whole data store (`data_store_template`) by a static pattern with `{UserId}` (case-sensitive), replaced with the user id of the request.

key_template.description: Deletes the matching key of a data store.

data_store_name.description: Data store holding the user's keys.

scope_pattern.description: Scope pattern, e.g. `Scope_{UserId}`. Defaults to `global` when omitted or empty.

data_store_template.description: Deletes the whole matching data store.

data_store_type.description: Only standard data stores can be deleted whole.
